LanguageData.MOASF_RemoveDesignator_Label: Remove replaced MO storage buildings from the architect menu
LanguageData.MOASF_RemoveDesignator_Desc: If enabled, those Medieval Overhaul storage buildings that this mod offers a replacement for are removed from the architect menu. Buildings without a replacement, such as the ice cellar, the hay bales and the market stalls, stay where they are. As those buildings are used for many different things, in dungeons, ruins, hideouts, and so on, they are not entirely removed from the game.
LanguageData.MOASF_RemoveContained_Label: Hide the contained items in MO's storage buildings
LanguageData.MOASF_RemoveContained_Desc: If enabled, the game will hide the content of the original Medieval Overhaul storage buildings.
LanguageData.MOASF_RestartRequired: These settings are applied while the game is loading. A change only takes effect after a restart.
LanguageData.EEG_CorpsePileBurnDesc: A colonist assigned to hauling sets the corpses in this pile on fire. The pile itself does not burn, but the fire can spread to anything nearby.
LanguageData.EEG_CorpsePileCancelBurnDesc: Nobody will set this pile on fire.
LanguageData.EEG_CorpsePileBurnEmpty: There are no corpses in this pile.
LanguageData.EEG_JunkPileBurnDesc: A colonist assigned to hauling sets everything flammable in this pile on fire. The pile itself does not burn, but the fire can spread to anything nearby.
LanguageData.EEG_JunkPileBurnEmpty: There is nothing flammable in this pile.
LanguageData.EEG_PileBurnFailed: Nothing in the {0} could be set on fire.
LanguageData.EEG_ServingNeedsTable: Must be placed on a table.
LanguageData.EEG_ServingAlreadyThere: There is already a plate, bowl or meal spot here.
LanguageData.EEG_CorpsePileBurnNotFlammable: None of the corpses in this pile can burn.
LanguageData.EEG_JunkPileBurnNotFlammable: There is nothing flammable in this pile.
